elsewhere.note: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to…
“Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,
backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
